hints.title: Two-Step Pixel Transformation
hints.text: Reverse each row horizontally and toggle binary values from zero to one and one to zero.

hints.title: Simultaneous Swap and Invert
hints.text: For each row, exchange row[c] and row[n - 1 - c] while simultaneously inverting both values.

hints.title: Bitwise Inversion Formulation
hints.text: Iterate column pointer up to the center column, setting row[c], row[n - 1 - c] = 1 - row[n - 1 - c], 1 - row[c].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: In-place two-pointer traversal per row in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate reversal and inversion passes double memory write traffic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) modifying matrix in place.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine horizontal reversal and 1 - x inversion in a single symmetric loop.
